description: [40 credits] [paid plans: + 40 per AI still unless ai_mode none; dry_run quotes] Turns a public web page into a narrated video: AI voiceover, motion graphics, optional subtitles. Asynchronous (minutes, sometimes past fifteen): returns a receipt with the video_id at once; get_video for the full status. A page behind a login is filmed only with a capture session from the VS Code or browser extension (Scale plan and up).

ai_budget.description: Ceiling on AI visuals, given to the planner.

on_exceed.description: Over the ceiling. refuse (default): create_animation creates nothing; create_video, planned after the call, keeps to the ceiling. fallback: renders, generating only up to the ceiling. queue: generates all.

ai_mode.description: AI visuals for beats the page cannot show (paid plans): none; assist = a few stills; rich = stills and clips within ai_budget. Omitted: assist where the plan generates, else none. Charged per visual, refunded on failure.

aspect_ratio.description: 9:16 (Reels/Shorts) films the page's MOBILE layout in a phone viewport; 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5 film the 1280-wide desktop layout.

brand_name.description: Name on the intro and outro cards; default the site's.

callback_url.description: https URL POSTed a JSON event when the render ends (done/held/error/cancelled), 3 tries. Verify: X-PageToVid-Signature = "sha256=" + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, X-PageToVid-Timestamp + "." + raw body); refuse timestamps over 5 min old. Secret: webhook_secret, shown once, or rotate_webhook_secret.

callout.description: What points at a screencast's subject.

caption_animation.description: What a spoken word does; overrides the look's.

caption_emphasis.description: Brand-coloured words: **asterisked** (manual), plus figures (auto), or none.

draft.description: Free preview: 1/3 resolution, DRAFT mark, no AI visuals. 5/hour. rerender_video without draft then makes the paid film, no re-plan.

dry_run.description: Quote only; nothing made or charged.

edit_style.description: Cutting rhythm (list_motions); a scene's own transition still wins.

focus.description: Context the page cannot show (an offer, the audience, a code, what to avoid). Anything here may be voiced as FACT in the customer's voice; a line in quotation marks is placed verbatim, usually as the hook.

generate_motion.description: Custom motion graphics for beats no built-in visual fits (AI plans or a film pass, else built-in).

goal.description: What the video is for; shapes the script.

grade.description: Footage colour grade; overrides the look's.

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the original video, uncharged. Without one, an identical call within 120 s returns the first video (idempotent_replay).

intro.description: Opening title card (1.5 s). Omitted: true, except goal "ad" (opens on its hook).

language.description: Language of the script and voiceover. Omitted: the page's own language, else its country domain's (.fr, .de…), else the account's.

look.description: The film's look: captions, cutting, sound cues, music family and motion together; auto varies with goal, shape and the site's films (list_video_options).

model.description: Clip model (list_models) for ai_mode rich, or auto (routed per scene, see optimize); omit for the house clip.

music.description: Music bed, "none", or "asset:<id>" (upload_asset). auto fits the goal and differs from the site's previous films.

optimize.description: With model auto: quality, balanced (default), speed or cost.

outputs.description: One storyboard in 1-4 shapes: the first is this video (replaces aspect_ratio), each other a sibling (get_video formats), a render each, started when the first ends.

press_effect.description: What the picture does on a click.

pronunciations.description: Voice-only lexicon, e.g. [{"text":"Nginx","say":"engine x"}]; captions keep the text.

quality_gate.description: auto_fix (default): dead air and colliding overlays fixed before rendering (auto_fixes). hold: also, a film scored under min_score ends "held" until release_video. deliver: as authored.

routing.description: {planner?: flash|pro, footage?: prefer-recorded|record-fresh}. flash is the benched default (pro is a choice, not an upgrade); prefer-recorded reuses the site's banked flow recordings.

subtitles.description: Burn captions in and emit a .vtt sidecar.

target_seconds.description: Length asked for: the words are written to fit it.

theme.description: Palette, type and mode; list_themes has the presets and rules, detect_brand reads a site's. Omitted: a filmed video adopts the page's CSS.

colors.description: Up to 2 hex accents, most important first, with real chroma and distinct hues; one the film cannot paint with is refused with the measurement. detect_brand reads a site's.

corners.description: Corner language for cards, chips and bars.

font.description: Type category. Implied by font_family when you set one.

font_family.description: A face from list_themes; any other is refused.

mode.description: dark (default), light, or brand (your colours fill the frame, white type).

negative.description: Hex colour washed over a scene marked mood PROBLEM. Defaults to red.

positive.description: Hex colour washed over a scene marked mood WIN. Defaults to your first accent.

tone.description: Narration delivery, e.g. calm, or a short direction.

url.description: Public http(s) page to film; you must have the right to.

voice.description: Narrator (all multilingual). auto picks a voice that fits the goal and tone and differs from the site's previous films.

name: create_video

ai_prices.description: Credits per clip, per still, and the ai_budget maximum (null: uncapped).

formats.description: Every shape: video_id, aspect_ratio, status, primary, video_url.

title: Create video from web page
